lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular pixel clusters of high luminance are arranged in approximate horizontal rows posterior to the gills, forming a regular geometric lattice.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper flank, marked by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to lower-luminance ventral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
